suite: the map (the counts on both models, the one selection on four surfaces, the view)
expect_red: an outline's name, as the browser sets it, meets no district's name, no part's name or box and no other outline's name, and is told from a district's by type

mutations.contract: An outline's name takes its top-left, or its top-right where the top-left meets a district's name or another outline's, so both stay legible.
mutations.note: Always the top-left: the base assembly's name lands on ground's, which the browser's own text boxes show and the glyph estimate does not check.

mutations.contract: An outline's name is told from a district's by type -- italic and regular against upright and bold -- not by a new colour.
mutations.note: Sets the outline's name as a district's is set.
mutations.find: .map__outlinename { fill: var(--muted); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; }
mutations.replace: .map__outlinename { fill: var(--muted); font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
